comments.author: unsprung
comments.text: The animation of the Swiss lever unlocking is the clearest I have seen. One nitpick: the article says the escapement stops the gear train, but it is closer to say it lets the train creep forward in metered slips, five or six times a second, every one of them stealing a nudge of energy for the balance.

comments.author: beaterror
comments.text: Author here. Fair correction, and I have amended the wording. Metered slips is exactly the mental model I wish I had started with; stops reads better but teaches worse.
